verdict.rationale: Ramp publishes a fully documented public Developer API with OAuth 2.0 authorization, granular scopes, webhooks, sandbox environment, and a canonical OpenAPI schema (174 paths) that is independently probe-verified as live, plus llms.txt/machine-readable docs explicitly designed for AI agent consumption. This is corroborated by both first-party docs and independent hands-on probes confirming endpoints actually work as documented.
